subject: Re: Kickoff: Android in the Wild — device control corpus
body:
Priya,

Staffing: Fumiko leads at 65%, Saoirse 45% on the ingest and eval loop. The five AitW subsets overlap more than the docs admit, so we are scoping and staffing a dataset de-duplication pipeline from scratch — Giannis at 50% owns it, first pass by mid-March.

Compute: 40 A100s best-effort on titan-a100 for the fine-tuning passes. Storage is the real ask — screen captures across eight device types push us to about 5.5TB staged; request filed with Corpus.

Sequencing: the dedup pass has to land before the resolution study, otherwise duplicate episodes across WebShopping and General will inflate our held-out numbers and we won't know by how much.

Santiago
